verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents tracking of all compliance requirements and deadlines, including annual reports and franchise tax reports, which it files on the founder's behalf. Its compliance dashboard shows per-state status and upcoming deadlines, and registered agent service is offered in all 50 states. However, the evidence describes a dashboard view and done-for-you filing, not proactive alerts sent ahead of each deadline. Missing for 10: documented proactive notifications (email/in-app) before annual report and franchise tax due dates, alert lead-time or configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the deadline tracking works across every agent state.
